#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, then validate the result.

The cover page is generated with reportlab (a letter-size page with the title
and the current date centered), prepended to the existing report.pdf pages,
and report.pdf is replaced in place via an atomic temp-file rename.
"""

import datetime
import os
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def make_cover_page(cover_path: str, date_str: str) -> None:
    c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title centered, upper-middle of the page.
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 3.0 * inch, TITLE)

    # Current date centered below the title.
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 3.75 * inch, date_str)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()


def main() -> None:
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{REPORT} not found in the working directory")

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    original_page_count = len(reader.pages)

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".pdf", delete=False) as tmp_cover:
        cover_path = tmp_cover.name
    try:
        make_cover_page(cover_path, date_str)

        cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)

        tmp_out = REPORT + ".tmp"
        with open(tmp_out, "wb") as f:
            writer.write(f)
        os.replace(tmp_out, REPORT)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(cover_path):
            os.remove(cover_path)

    # Validate the resulting file.
    final_reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    final_count = len(final_reader.pages)
    assert final_count == original_page_count + 1, (
        f"expected {original_page_count + 1} pages, got {final_count}"
    )

    # Confirm the cover page text is present on page 1.
    page_one_text = final_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert TITLE in page_one_text, "cover title missing from page 1"
    assert date_str in page_one_text, "cover date missing from page 1"

    print(f"Added cover page to {REPORT}: title '{TITLE}', date '{date_str}'")
    print(f"Pages: {original_page_count} -> {final_count}")
    print("Validation passed: cover title and date present on page 1.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date.

Only report.pdf is transformed: the cover page is rendered in memory with reportlab and
merged ahead of the existing pages with pypdf, then written back to report.pdf.
"""
import datetime
import io
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def build_cover_pdf() -> io.BytesIO:
    """Render a single letter-size cover page in memory and return it as a BytesIO."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title centered in the upper-middle of the page.
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.62, TITLE)

    # Current date centered below the title.
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.52, date_str)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    buf.seek(0)
    return buf


def main() -> None:
    # Load the existing report fully into memory before rewriting the same file.
    with open(INPUT_PDF, "rb") as f:
        original_bytes = f.read()
    reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(original_bytes))
    print(f"Original report.pdf has {len(reader.pages)} page(s)")

    cover_reader = PdfReader(build_cover_pdf())

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(INPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    print(f"Added cover page ('{TITLE}', {datetime.date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y')}) to {INPUT_PDF}")
    print(f"report.pdf now has {len(reader.pages) + 1} page(s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def serialize_pdf(objs, root_num):
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objs):
        offsets[num] = len(out)

    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % count
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, count):
        if num in offsets:
            out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (

    body_start = eol + 1
    end = data.find(b"endobj", body_start)
    if end == -1:
        raise RuntimeError("endobj not found at offset %d" % off)
    stream_kw = data.find(b"stream", body_start, end)
    if stream_kw != -1:
        es = data.find(b"endstream", stream_kw)
        if es == -1:
            raise RuntimeError("endstream not found at offset %d" % off)
        end = data.find(b"endobj", es)
        if end == -1:
            raise RuntimeError("endobj after endstream not found at offset %d" % off)
    return data[body_start:end].rstrip(b"\r\n")

        while p < len(data) and data[p:p + 1] in (b" ", b"\r", b"\n", b"\t"):

    else:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, then validate the result.

The cover page is generated with reportlab (a letter-size page with the title
and the current date centered), prepended to the existing report.pdf pages,
and report.pdf is replaced in place via an atomic temp-file rename.
"""

import datetime
import os
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def make_cover_page(cover_path: str, date_str: str) -> None:
    c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title centered, upper-middle of the page.
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 3.0 * inch, TITLE)

    # Current date centered below the title.
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 3.75 * inch, date_str)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()


def main() -> None:
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{REPORT} not found in the working directory")

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    original_page_count = len(reader.pages)

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".pdf", delete=False) as tmp_cover:
        cover_path = tmp_cover.name
    try:
        make_cover_page(cover_path, date_str)

        cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)

        tmp_out = REPORT + ".tmp"
        with open(tmp_out, "wb") as f:
            writer.write(f)
        os.replace(tmp_out, REPORT)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(cover_path):
            os.remove(cover_path)

    # Validate the resulting file.
    final_reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    final_count = len(final_reader.pages)
    assert final_count == original_page_count + 1, (
        f"expected {original_page_count + 1} pages, got {final_count}"
    )

    # Confirm the cover page text is present on page 1.
    page_one_text = final_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert TITLE in page_one_text, "cover title missing from page 1"
    assert date_str in page_one_text, "cover date missing from page 1"

    print(f"Added cover page to {REPORT}: title '{TITLE}', date '{date_str}'")
    print(f"Pages: {original_page_count} -> {final_count}")
    print("Validation passed: cover title and date present on page 1.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Backends, tried in order:
  1. reportlab (cover) + pypdf/PyPDF2 (merge)

import importlib

INPUT_NAME = "report.pdf"
PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter, points


def find_input():

def require(module_name):

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- backend 1
def backend_reportlab_pypdf(input_path, tmp_out, date_str):
    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
    from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

    if require("pypdf"):

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- backend 2
def backend_fitz(input_path, tmp_out, date_str):

                     fontsize=16, fontname="helv")

def text_width(s, bold, size):
    table = HELV_BOLD if bold else HELV
    total = sum(table.get(ord(ch), 500) for ch in s)
    return total * size / 1000.0


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def serialize_pdf(objs, root_num):
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objs):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        gen, body = objs[num]
        out += b"%d %d obj\n" % (num, gen)
        out += body
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    count = max(objs) + 1
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % count
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, count):
        if num in offsets:
            out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (
        count, root_num, xref_pos)
    return bytes(out)


def read_object_at(data, off):
    kw = data.find(b"obj", off)
    if kw == -1:
        raise RuntimeError("bad object header at offset %d" % off)
    eol = data.find(b"\n", kw)
    body_start = eol + 1
    end = data.find(b"endobj", body_start)
    if end == -1:
        raise RuntimeError("endobj not found at offset %d" % off)
    stream_kw = data.find(b"stream", body_start, end)
    if stream_kw != -1:
        es = data.find(b"endstream", stream_kw)
        if es == -1:
            raise RuntimeError("endstream not found at offset %d" % off)
        end = data.find(b"endobj", es)
        if end == -1:
            raise RuntimeError("endobj after endstream not found at offset %d" % off)
    return data[body_start:end].rstrip(b"\r\n")


def parse_classic_xref(data, pos):
    entries = {}
    p = pos + len(b"xref")
    while True:
        while p < len(data) and data[p:p + 1] in (b" ", b"\r", b"\n", b"\t"):
            p += 1
        line_end = data.find(b"\n", p)
        if line_end == -1:
            line_end = len(data)
        line = data[p:line_end].strip()
        p = line_end + 1
        if line == b"trailer" or not line:
            break
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 2:
            break
        start, count = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])
        for i in range(count):
            entry = data[p:p + 20]
            p += 20
            if len(entry) < 20:
                break
            off = int(entry[0:10])
            gen = int(entry[11:16])
            typ = entry[17:18]
            if typ == b"n" and off > 0:
                entries.setdefault(start + i, (off, gen))
    return entries, p


def backend_stdlib(input_path, tmp_out, date_str):
    with open(input_path, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()

    starts = re.findall(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not starts:
        raise RuntimeError("input PDF has no startxref")
    offsets, size = {}, None
    root_ref = info_ref = None
    pos = int(starts[-1])
    seen = set()
    while pos and pos not in seen:
        seen.add(pos)
        if not data[pos:pos + 4] == b"xref":
            raise RuntimeError("input PDF uses an xref stream; stdlib fallback "
                               "cannot merge it (no PDF library is installed)")
        entries, p = parse_classic_xref(data, pos)
        for num, val in entries.items():
            offsets.setdefault(num, val)
        tline = data.find(b"trailer", p)
        if tline == -1:
            break
        tend = data.find(b"startxref", tline)
        trailer = data[tline:tend] if tend != -1 else data[tline:]
        m = re.search(rb"/Size\s+(\d+)", trailer)
        if m:
            size = int(m.group(1))
        m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", trailer)
        if m:
            root_ref = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)))
        m = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", trailer)
        if m:
            info_ref = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)))
        m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer)
        pos = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0

    if root_ref is None:
        raise RuntimeError("input PDF trailer has no /Root")
    root_num = root_ref[0]
    root_text = read_object_at(data, offsets[root_num][0])
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", root_text)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("input PDF catalog has no /Pages")
    pages_num = int(m.group(1))
    pages_text = read_object_at(data, offsets[pages_num][0])
    m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", pages_text)
    if not m:

  1. reportlab (cover) + pypdf/PyPDF2 (merge)
  2. PyMuPDF (fitz) alone
  3. pure Python standard library (manual PDF construction + classic-xref merge)

def find_input():
    candidates = [os.path.join(os.getcwd(), INPUT_NAME)]
    script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    if script_dir != os.getcwd():
        candidates.append(os.path.join(script_dir, INPUT_NAME))
    for path in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(path):
            return path
    return None


def today_string():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%B %d, %Y")


def require(module_name):
    try:

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- backend 1
def backend_reportlab_pypdf(input_path, tmp_out, date_str):
    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
    from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

    if require("pypdf"):
        from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
    else:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader, PdfWriter

    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.58, TITLE)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.50, date_str)
    c.save()
    buf.seek(0)

    reader = PdfReader(input_path)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(PdfReader(buf).pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open(tmp_out, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    return "reportlab+pypdf", len(writer.pages)

def backend_fitz(input_path, tmp_out, date_str):
    import fitz

                     fontsize=30, fontname="hebo")
    page.insert_text(((PAGE_W - w2) / 2.0, PAGE_H * 0.50), date_str,
                     fontsize=16, fontname="helv")
    merged.insert_pdf(src)  # appends every original page after the cover
    merged.save(tmp_out, garbage=3, deflate=True)
    total = merged.page_count
    merged.close()
    src.close()
    return "fitz", total

def text_width(s, bold, size):
    table = HELV_BOLD if bold else HELV
    total = sum(table.get(ord(ch), 500) for ch in s)
    return total * size / 1000.0


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def serialize_pdf(objs, root_num):
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objs):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        gen, body = objs[num]
        out += b"%d %d obj\n" % (num, gen)
        out += body
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    count = max(objs) + 1
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % count
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, count):
        if num in offsets:
            out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (
        count, root_num, xref_pos)
    return bytes(out)


def read_object_at(data, off):
    kw = data.find(b"obj", off)
    if kw == -1:
        raise RuntimeError("bad object header at offset %d" % off)
    eol = data.find(b"\n", kw)
    body_start = eol + 1
    end = data.find(b"endobj", body_start)
    if end == -1:
        raise RuntimeError("endobj not found at offset %d" % off)
    stream_kw = data.find(b"stream", body_start, end)
    if stream_kw != -1:
        es = data.find(b"endstream", stream_kw)
        if es == -1:
            raise RuntimeError("endstream not found at offset %d" % off)
        end = data.find(b"endobj", es)
        if end == -1:
            raise RuntimeError("endobj after endstream not found at offset %d" % off)
    return data[body_start:end].rstrip(b"\r\n")


def parse_classic_xref(data, pos):
    entries = {}
    p = pos + len(b"xref")
    while True:
        while p < len(data) and data[p:p + 1] in (b" ", b"\r", b"\n", b"\t"):
            p += 1
        line_end = data.find(b"\n", p)
        if line_end == -1:
            line_end = len(data)
        line = data[p:line_end].strip()
        p = line_end + 1
        if line == b"trailer" or not line:
            break
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 2:
            break
        start, count = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])
        for i in range(count):
            entry = data[p:p + 20]
            p += 20
            if len(entry) < 20:
                break
            off = int(entry[0:10])
            gen = int(entry[11:16])
            typ = entry[17:18]
            if typ == b"n" and off > 0:
                entries.setdefault(start + i, (off, gen))
    return entries, p


def backend_stdlib(input_path, tmp_out, date_str):
    with open(input_path, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()

    starts = re.findall(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not starts:
        raise RuntimeError("input PDF has no startxref")
    offsets, size = {}, None
    root_ref = info_ref = None
    pos = int(starts[-1])
    seen = set()
    while pos and pos not in seen:
        seen.add(pos)
        if not data[pos:pos + 4] == b"xref":
            raise RuntimeError("input PDF uses an xref stream; stdlib fallback "
                               "cannot merge it (no PDF library is installed)")
        entries, p = parse_classic_xref(data, pos)
        for num, val in entries.items():
            offsets.setdefault(num, val)
        tline = data.find(b"trailer", pos)
        if tline == -1:
            raise RuntimeError("no trailer dict found after xref at %d" % pos)
        tend = data.find(b"startxref", tline)
        trailer = data[tline:tend] if tend != -1 else data[tline:]
        m = re.search(rb"/Size\s+(\d+)", trailer)
        if m:
            size = int(m.group(1))
        m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", trailer)
        if m:
            root_ref = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)))
        m = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", trailer)
        if m:
            info_ref = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)))
        m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", trailer)
        pos = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0

        raise RuntimeError("input PDF trailer has no /Root")
    root_num = root_ref[0]

    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", root_text)

    merged = serialize_pdf(objs, new_catalog)
    with open(tmp_out, "wb") as fh:

    return "stdlib", orig_count + 1
